name: Milwaukee Zen Center / Kokyo-an
reason: Own site not kept current and no usable contact route: milwaukeezencenter.org (read 13 Nov 2026) shows newsletters and events only up to 2015, an empty talks page, and no email on any page read; its contact page redirects to plain http, which the rules treat as unreachable. The only address (an earthlink.net one) is on the SZBA list, not the centre's own site. Also flag: the home page carries an unrelated injected link (voymedia.com) inside its text about shikantaza.
